provenance.authoring_note: This source records a separate candidate-by-candidate M9-B review. M5 fit and reserve evidence sets historical order only; new lexical dispositions, exact-search checks, and ordinary shared admission determine current recovery.

review.method: Review each selected historical source row, exact authored lexical unit and gloss, present canonical/search identity, supported POS and bounded sense; for every single-sense candidate, compare exact gloss-span sentence frames with the next writer route; hold unresolved lexical and sense boundaries; admit only source-supported standalone units through shared admission; add no unsupported relations.
criteria: exact historical inventory and M5-13 source identity binding
fresh lexical-unit and supported POS review independent of M5 fit/reserve
bounded current sense without unsupported sense splitting
exact canonical and generated-search ownership absence
zero relations allowed without relation fabrication
single-sense gloss spans, sentence frames, and next writer routes are explicitly compared before fresh admission

correction_passes.method: Re-evaluated the admitted Issue #220 single-sense decisions under the clarified writer-route criterion; object and argument differences count as one sense when both frames lead to the same replacement route.
